children: On August 27, 2026, the company received notice from Nasdaq that the aggregate market value of its outstanding warrants fell below $1 million, violating Nasdaq Listing Rule 5452(b)(C). The company has 45 days to submit a compliance plan, with a potential extension to February 23, 2027 if accepted. The notice has no immediate effect and applies only to the warrants; other securities are unaffected.
